text:
Nuremberg’s median asking rent sits at 12.89 €/m², up 4.0 % year‑on‑year and 23.3 % over the past five years, placing the city 14th among the 37 most expensive German markets. The 31‑day average time on market and an 18 % share of listings let within a week signal a balanced market, while the vacancy rate remains low at 1.6 %.

Asking rents are 57 % above the 2022 existing‑rent level of 8.21 €/m², pushing a typical 60 m² apartment to 773 € per month and creating a rent‑burden of 17.1 % for two residents. The market’s tightness is reinforced by modest population growth of 1.5 % over five years.

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent at 13.55 €/m² in 12 months, with a range of 13.24 – 13.85 €/m², implying a 5.1 % increase.
